name: MiniMax-H3
title_zh: 一套 11 个技能，拆开单卖不如整包拿走
tagline_zh: 不用挨个搜、挨个试、挨个配。MiniMax-H3 把 11 个常用技能打包好，装一次顶装十一次。
tagline_en: Stop hunting, testing, configuring one by one. MiniMax-H3 bundles 11 everyday skills into one install — saves.
why_zh: 不是技能列表的堆砌，而是按「高频场景」挑过的组合。装完即用，依赖和冲突已替你踩平。
why_en: Not a random list — a curated set for high-frequency tasks. Pre-resolved dependencies and conflicts, so it works out-of-box.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 MiniMax 自家模型生态，换到 OpenAI/Claude 等外部 API 时技能会失效。
limit_en: Works only within MiniMax's own model ecosystem; breaks with external APIs like OpenAI/Claude. 11 generic templates, no vertical-industry logic.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 11 skills in one pack, better than buying singly
